header.publisher: Indiana Department of Revenue (Departmental Notice #1, effective Oct. 1, 2026)
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Values hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. Rate: Indiana DOR Departmental Notice #1: "For 2026, the state adjusted gross income tax rate for individuals is 2.95%" (2.9% scheduled for 2027). No standard deduction. Exemptions: $1,000 per federal exemption (taxpayer, spouse, dependents); additional $1,500 per qualifying dependent child (larger first-year and adopted-child amounts); additional $1,000 for each taxpayer/spouse age 65 or over (seniorExtraDeduction) and $1,000 if blind; plus a further $500 per person 65+ if federal AGI is under $40,000 ($20,000 MFS). Starts from federal AGI. Social Security and railroad retirement benefits are deducted in full. Retirement income: no general exclusion (a civil service annuity deduction and a military retirement pay deduction exist; not modeled). NOT MODELED: county local income taxes apply on top of the state rate to Indiana adjusted gross income, at the rate of the county of residence on January 1 (roughly 0.5% to 3%; see the county table in Departmental Notice #1). No capital-gains exclusion. Cross-checked against Tax Foundation, "State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026" (data as of Jan 1 2026, updated Feb 11 2026).

flags.seniorExtraDeduction: simplified: $1,000 per person 65+; an extra $500 applies if federal AGI < $40,000 ($20,000 MFS)
